headline: Budget review, a Mechanics Park utility box painting proposal, and a draft Percent for Art timeline.
summary: The agenda includes a Master Plan update, a vote on two logo drafts, and a report on the open voting seat and youth seat. Members will also hear a presentation called 'There Are No Words' and review a list of 17 potential projects.
